scope: Corollary 1.2 (Regular MaxCut in successive limits) of the manuscript “QAOA attains the SK ground-state energy in the thermodynamic-first limit” (preprints/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 281 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d07ebe181b03157), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every η > 0 there are an integer p ≥ 1, deterministic normalized angles γ, β ∈ Rp, and an integer D0 ≥ 2 such that, for every integer D ≥ D0 and every finite simple unweighted (D + 1)-regular graph G of girth greater than 2p + 1, qp,G(2γ/ √ D, β) ≥ 1 2 + P∗ − η √ D . (1.6) The word p, γ, β is independent of D, the graph size, and G; the displayed usual MaxCut cost angles, unlike the normalized angles γ, are scaled with the degree. Let Gn,d be uniform among simple labelled d-regular graphs on n vertices, along admissible n with nd even. For the same word, put ∆D(G) = OPT(G) − qp,G(2γ/ √ D, β). The word may be chosen so that lim D→∞ lim sup n→∞ n(D+1) even Pr G h√ D ∆D(Gn,D+1) > η i = 0. (1.7) Here the inner limit keeps D, p, γ, β fixed, and PrG is only over the graph: qp,G already averages quantum measurement.
